description: Search the appointment calendar by date range, customer, order or technician. Returns appointments with their customer. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/appointment/search.

endFrom.description: Appointments ending at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

endTo.description: Appointments ending at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

includeUnassigned.description: With technicians, also include unassigned appointments.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

orderId.description: Only appointments linked to this order.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for paging (use with limit).

sort.description: Sort by start date. Default asc.

startFrom.description: Appointments starting at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

startTo.description: Appointments starting at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

technicians.description: Only appointments assigned to these technician (user) ids.

name: shopmonkey_search_appointments
title: Search appointments
